name: Hinged Dock Door
shortDescription: Hinged door that can be opened and closed using an on/off signal.

logicNodes.label: Open/Close
logicNodes.description: Opens the door when receiving an on signal, and closes it when receiving an off signal.

logicNodes.label: Magnet Toggle
logicNodes.description: Enables the door's magnet when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: On/Off Sent
logicNodes.description: An on/off signal to send to a connected door.

logicNodes.label: Connected
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if the door is attached to another door.

logicNodes.label: On/Off Received
logicNodes.description: The on/off signal received from a connected door.

logicNodes.label: Number Sent
logicNodes.description: A number signal to send to a connected door.

logicNodes.label: Number Received
logicNodes.description: The number value received from a connected door.
